race.description: More From Tote With Ladbrokes Mbl Pace
race.comment: ATOMIC BLACK (1) has been racing well, filling a top-five position at his last five starts including a second most recently at Launceston over 2200m. Has the benefit of a good draw. Big chance in a similar race. EVERYTHING BUT THE (2) finished second last start over 1609m at this track, beaten a nose. Best recent result was a win at Launceston three starts ago. Will enjoy a nice run from this favourable starting position. Tackles a similar assignment and he can give this a mighty shake. RAY DAN (3) disappointed last time when tenth over 2200m at Launceston. Can turn things around. JOHN VINCENT (5) must be respected after scoring last start by a nose at this track over 1609m.
